say: Against Aris, the second-best baseline, it wins thirteen tasks of twenty. Under a second judge it stays level with Aris, behind only Claude Code.
phonemes: ɐɡˈɛnst ˈæɹɪs, ðə sˈɛkəndbˈɛst bˈeɪslaɪn, ɪt wˈɪnz θˈɜːtiːn tˈæsks ʌv twˈɛnti. ˌʌndɚɹ ɐ sˈɛkənd dʒˈʌdʒ ɪt stˈeɪz lˈɛvəl wɪð ˈæɹɪs, bᵻhˌaɪnd ˈoʊnli klˈɔːd kˈoʊd.
